text:
Devon: ping — escalating SR-12456 from Nimbly. They see embedded app users immediately drop to reauth after an admin password/credential rotation. Happens across Chrome on Android and iOS Safari webviews. Customer reports: users click in embedded widget -> instant 'please sign in' modal -> completes SSO -> bounce back to widget but still unauthenticated.

Devon: Quick summary: suspect cookie rotation + SameSite/domain/path mismatch. Happened right after they rotated creds this morning. Repro steps I followed: 1) Login via SSO in org1.nimbly.app 2) Admin triggers password reset/force-reauth for user 3) User in embedded widget (hosted at app.customer.com) tries action -> 401 from our API -> SDK opens reauth -> after successful reauth SDK loops.

Devon: Collected response headers from a repro session (sanitized):
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Set-Cookie: rwd_refresh=eyJhbGci...; Path=/auth; Domain=org1.nimbly.app; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=1209600
Set-Cookie: rwd_session=eyJld...; Path=/; Domain=customer.app; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=None; Max-Age=3600
X-Session-Version: v3
```

Devon: Note the refresh cookie Path/Domain doesn't match the embedded host, and SameSite=Lax on the refresh. The SDK expects refresh to be accessible from the embed origin to perform background renewals. Also saw TTL mismatch: session store shows new token already issued but cookie expires slightly earlier than server-side session TTL which causes immediate invalidation in some edge cases (race).

ops-bot: Incident alert created: INC-2024-4326 (linked to SR-12456) :rotating_light:

Chris: @Devon thanks — this smells like two separate problems: (1) cookie attributes being set by the auth plane using tenant domain not the embed host, and (2) refresh rotation order allowing a short window where cookie and server session are out of sync. Could be LB or our cookie-rewrite proxy doing domain translations.

Chris: Quick repro curl you can run from an external host (sanitized):
```
curl -i -c /tmp/cjar -b /tmp/cjar -H "Origin: https://app.customer.com" \
  -X POST https://org1.nimbly.app/auth/renew -d '{"grant_type":"refresh_token"}'
```

Chris: If the Set-Cookie coming back uses org1.nimbly.app domain, the browser won't send it for app.customer.com (embed). For webviews it can be worse because sameSite semantics + webview cookie storage varies.

Maya: Adding a note from security/device-trust side — @Devon @Chris, check device JWT rotation. If device-bound tokens are rotated but the SDK's device_jwt header is still the old binding, our token verification will reject the new cookie (silent 401). Look for mismatch in the following header on failed calls: `X-Device-JWT-Version`. We had one past regression where device_jwt rekeying produced a different kid and the client didn't refresh binding until next full login.

Devon: I grabbed a failed API log sample (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-14T09:42:12Z] request_id=abcd-1234 user_id=u-998 status=401 route=/v1/chat prompt=... x-device-jwt-version=2 x-session-version=3
[2026-03-14T09:42:12Z] auth_err=refresh_invalid_or_expired cookie_name=rwd_refresh
```

Chris: Can infra please grep for any cookie-rewrite rules that alter Domain/Path or set SameSite based on tenant header? @ops — look for nginx `proxy_cookie_domain` / `proxy_cookie_path` or our auth-proxy middleware. If found we should prefer leaving Domain unset (host-only) for embed flows or explicitly set Domain to the embed host and SameSite=None + Secure.

Maya: Also, add a short-term mitigation: make the SDK fall back to full-page OAuth redirect when embedded refresh fails with 401 twice in a row instead of looping immediate reauth modal. That reduces user impact while infra patches cookie rotation order.

Chris: I'll take ownership to check LB/proxy config and rotation ordering. Plan: (1) confirm whether cookie set uses tenant domain vs request host (2) ensure refresh rotation is atomic server-side (set new server session before issuing new cookie) (3) if required, patch auth-plane to set SameSite=None for flows where Origin header != auth host. Will update in 2 hours.

Devon: I'm leaving a note for Nimbly support: "We're investigating cookie/domain and device-token rotation. Short-term workaround: open widget in top-level page (not iframe) or use full-page SSO. Engineering investigating atomic rotation. ETA 2-3 hours for root cause; we'll push a patch if LB rewrite is the culprit."

Nimbly-Support: Thanks team — customer is reachable for a screenshare at 11:15 PT. Keep me posted and I’ll coordinate. :pray:

Chris: quick config snippet we should search for on the proxy: `proxy_cookie_domain $upstream_host $host;` and `add_header Set-Cookie ... SameSite=Lax;` — both are red flags for embeds. Also check any legacy middleware that forces tenant-based Domain.

Devon: I'll attach the raw HAR and SDK debug logs to the SR. If anyone wants the sample cURL output I posted earlier I can paste the full response headers.

Chris: assigning to eng-infra (ticket INF-6789) — tagging @chris @maya for follow-ups.

Maya: security will validate device-jwt rotation logic and add an integration test for rekey during forced-reauth.

Devon: thanks all. I'll keep this thread updated with any customer feedback from the 11:15 call. :thumbsup:
